profile.name: PWM GPIO输出设备
profile.description: 一种通过GPIO引脚输出脉宽调制信号的通用硬件输出设备，可调节占空比与频率。在实验中常用于驱动LED亮度、蜂鸣器输出或经适当驱动电路控制电机等简单致动负载。
profile.description_en: A generic hardware output device that emits pulse-width modulated signals through a GPIO pin, with adjustable duty cycle and frequency. In laboratory setups it is commonly used to drive simple actuators such as LED brightness, buzzer output, or motor power through suitable interface circuitry.

registry.name: Generic GPIO output device
registry.description: Pwm Output Device是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、关闭。支持Signal, Slot, active high等操作。
